ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** with Remind me here set on a photo, start a walk, stand still a minute with the phone face up, then put the app in the background and walk past the spot. **Expect:** the reminder fires once in the background, as it did before code-quality: the recorder's tail is read without still spells or gap fills on purpose (`// readTrace:` in `recorder/index.native.ts`; code-quality audit, native list)

- [ ] **Do:** close the app mid-walk for two minutes, reopen it on the walk screen. **Expect:** the trace resumes, and the newest gap is reported as before (`newestGap` and `sameRuns` now come from `lib/liveTrace`, a core module the native bundle has not loaded yet; refactor recording 1-2)

- Code-quality audit 13, the rest (deferred): named colours (`'white'`) are not counted as colour literals (too many plain words would read as colours before the palette exists); `.catch(noop)` with a named empty function is not followed to its body; a promise an arrow hands back to a JSX handler (`onPress={() => save()}`) is not a floating promise to the type pass
